🦃 A little behind-the-scenes turkey roundup at Roswell Family Farm.

Waylon, Willow, and Wyatt were helping us round up a turkey in the barn when these photos were taken.

Our kids are growing up seeing where food comes from and the work involved in raising animals. These are some of the real moments behind our family farm here in Salisbury/Dolgeville, NY.

Planning your Thanksgiving table? Consider a turkey from Roswell Family Farm.

🔥🐷 THE PIT BOSS IS FIRED UP AT ROSWELL FAMILY FARM! 🛸👽

Tonight we’re smoking up a beautiful rack of St. Louis-style spare ribs, cut in half, and putting a little BBQ debate to the test!

Both halves got a mustard binder and a generous coating of our RFF Signature BBQ Rib Rub before hitting the Pit Boss at a low-and-slow 180–200°F. 💨🔥

But here’s where things get interesting…

🥩 LEFT HALF: Membrane removed

🥩 RIGHT HALF: Membrane left on

Same rack. Same preparation. Same seasoning. Same smoker. Two different approaches!

We’re giving these ribs a couple hours of low-and-slow smoke before wrapping them with a splash of apple cider vinegar and cranking up the heat.

Then comes the finishing touch… a sweet, sticky BBQ glaze! 🤤🔥

We’re shooting for that perfect competition-style bite — tender, juicy meat that pulls cleanly away from the bone without falling apart!

🏆 NOW IT’S YOUR TURN TO WEIGH IN!

👇 Are you TEAM MEMBRANE OFF or TEAM MEMBRANE ON?

And how do you like your ribs — fall-off-the-bone tender or competition-style with just a little bite?

We’ll be sharing the finished results later tonight to see which half takes the crown! 👑

Because around here, good BBQ isn’t just dinner… it’s an experience that’s out of this world! 🛸

A farm name means more when you know the people behind it.

We’re Anthony and Emily Roswell, the family behind Roswell Family Farm in Salisbury/Dolgeville, NY.

Caring for animals together became something our family loved. As the farm grew, that connection became part of what we wanted to share with our community.

If you’re finding us for the first time, welcome. This page is where we share the animals, the work, and the family behind the Roswell name.

Follow along for a closer look at farm life here in Upstate New York. 🌱

Meet our farm: https://roswellfamilyfarm.com/about.html
